answer.reason: The verses add that Nadab did evil and besieged Gibbethon, beyond the summary's parentage and death at Baasha's hands.

clauses.english: did evil in the sight of the LORD, walking in his father's sin
clauses.quote: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

clauses.english: laid siege to the Philistine town of Gibbethon with all Israel
clauses.quote: Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon
